description: Soy Técnico Superior en Mecatrónica especializado en automatización, sistemas SCADA, hardware IoT (ESP32), desarrollo web e IA. Nuestro objetivo es crear un prototipo real y funcional integrando datos satelitales de la NASA con telemetría y visualización interactiva para pelear el podio local y la instancia global. Buscamos sumar integrantes con ganas de aportar en diseño/UI, datos, investigación, video/pitch o programación. ¡Sumate!
summary:
TERRA-SHIFT SCADA is an open-source agricultural climate-adaptation decision-support platform and routerless rural IIoT SCADA developed by Team INANNA (from Río Cuarto, the agro-industrial heart of Córdoba, Argentina, competing at the Santa Rosa de Calamuchita Local Event) for "Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data." Climate change is shifting temperatures, frost windows, and rainfall across farming belts from Río Cuarto to Calamuchita, while rural connectivity gaps prevent farmers from turning macro satellite pixels into field action.

Our platform queries live 20-year NASA POWER agroclimatology series and renders live NASA EOSDIS GIBS satellite layers (MODIS NDVI, SMAP Root-Zone Soil Moisture, MODIS Land Surface Temperature, and VIIRS) for any clicked farm GPS coordinate on Earth. It models 2035–2050 CMIP6 (SSP2-4.5/SSP5-8.5) crop suitability shifts across 10 traditional and resilient crops (sorghum, chickpea, peanut, olive, pistachio, and high-altitude Malbec), paired with a Guided Neural Voice Tour (EN/ES/PT). Finally, it bridges orbital data with offline-first ESP32 field nodes (AES-128 ESP-NOW + industrial 4–20 mA probes with NAMUR NE43 broken-wire protection and Modbus TCP/RTU) for fail-safe irrigation.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

OVERVIEW — WHAT TERRA-SHIFT SCADA DOES
TERRA-SHIFT SCADA (engineered by contestant Team INANNA from Río Cuarto, Córdoba, Argentina — competing at the Santa Rosa de Calamuchita Local Event: Fabio Maximiliano Medina Rojas [Higher Technician in Mechatronics], Agustín Alejandro Debia, and Iván David Coria, available trilingually in English | Español | Português) is an end-to-end Orbital-to-Root Agricultural Climate Adaptation and Rural Automation System. It helps smallholder farmers, agricultural cooperatives, agronomists, and regional water managers answer two critical questions:
1) Which traditional crops are losing climate viability on my exact parcel over the next 10 to 25 years, and which climate-resilient crops and water strategies offer higher harvest stability and climate resilience?
2) How do we execute precision water adaptation in rural fields that lack reliable Wi-Fi or cellular coverage and where low-cost analog sensors fail?

HOW IT WORKS — DUAL-LAYER ORBITAL + INDUSTRIAL ARCHITECTURE
1. Live Planetary Intelligence Layer (Macro Scale):
- Click any GPS coordinate on Earth or select regional agro-presets (Santa Rosa de Calamuchita, Río Cuarto Pampas Core, Traslasierra, Mendoza, San Joaquin Valley).
- Fetches live 20-year historical series (2004–2024) from the NASA POWER Agroclimatology REST API (T2M, T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN, PRECTOTCORR, GWETROOT root-zone soil wetness, GWETTOP, ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN solar irradiance, and RH2M) and renders live NASA EOSDIS GIBS WMTS satellite layers (MODIS Terra NDVI, SMAP L4 Root-Zone Soil Moisture, MODIS Land Surface Temperature, and VIIRS True Color).
- Combines Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) decadal trends with NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 regional projections (SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5 for 2035 and 2050) to score 10 traditional and alternative crops across thermal envelopes, pollination heat-shock penalties, frost limits, and water balance under Rainfed, Regenerative Cover-Crop, and Precision IIoT Drip strategies.

2. Advanced Decision-Support & Mechatronic Extensions:
- Guided Neural Voice Tour Narrated by Inanna (EN / ES / PT): An interactive spoken orientation experience embedded within both the live SCADA application and the 7-slide demonstration deck, walking farmers and evaluators through orbital indicators, crop transitions, and rural telemetry in English, Spanish, or Portuguese.
- 12-Month Seasonal Phenology & Frost/Heat Calendar: Dynamic month-by-month thermal tracking identifying shifted frost windows, late-spring freeze risks, and pollination heat-stress windows under CMIP6 warming.
- Farm-Scale Freshwater Conservation, VFD Pump Affinity-Law (P ∝ N³) Energy & Carbon Impact Simulator: Quantifies real pumping energy consumption, carbon abatement, and freshwater savings (conserving up to 38% water) when moving from fixed-speed throttling to variable-frequency driven (VFD) pressure regulation governed by centrifugal pump affinity laws.
- Live Interactive Mechatronic P&ID Kirchhoff Blueprint: An interactive schematic visualizer of the 4–20 mA NAMUR NE43 transmitter loop, differential ADC, safety interlock relay, and ESP-NOW bridge.
- Auto-Demo Jury Mode: A single-click evaluation mode allowing judges to quickly explore scenarios and simulations across all features.
- 3 Official Trilingual Manuals (English | Español | Português): Scientific & Mechatronic KaTeX Formulas Reference, Zero-Knowledge Farmer Plug & Play Deployment Guide, and Industrial CBM (Condition-Based Maintenance) Manual.

3. Routerless Ground-Truth & Irrigation SCADA Layer (Micro Scale):
- Macro satellite pixels (9 km SMAP) cannot detect a clogged drip line or a rodent-cut field cable. We pair NASA GWETROOT orbital data with open industrial ESP32 C++ firmware:
- 4–20 mA Current Loop + NAMUR NE43 Live-Zero Diagnostics: Field probes use a 24V DC loop across a precision 165.0 Ohm (0.1%) Kirchhoff shunt resistor and 16-bit ADS1115 differential ADC. When current drops below 3.60 mA (cut wire or power loss), naive sensors read 0% moisture and flood the crop; TERRA-SHIFT triggers an instant NAMUR NE43 Underscale Fault, locks the safety interlock relay, and falls back to NASA's orbital moisture budget until operator SCADA Alarm ACK.
- AES-128 ESP-NOW Rural Mesh & Modbus RTU/TCP: Solar field nodes transmit P2P MAC-to-MAC telemetry (<4 ms latency) without routers or cellular plans to a central ESP32 Gateway exposing fixed-point (x100) registers over isolated RS485 (MAX485 Modbus RTU) and Modbus TCP (Port 502), with NVS flash persistence for pump horometers and Local Wi-Fi AP diagnostics.

INCLUSIVE 3-TIER ADOPTION (PC-ONLY SMALLHOLDER TO AGRO-INDUSTRY) & 6 MODULAR SOLAR LoRa 915 MHz + ESP32 OFF-GRID DEVICES

3 Inclusive Adoption Tiers (Scaling from a Single Family PC to Large Estates):
- Tier 1 — Zero Hardware Mode (Just a Basic PC or Phone | Family & Smallholder Farms, 0.5–15 ha): Requires zero electronics, boards, or sensors. Using only a home or school PC (cached offline as a Progressive Web App), farmers click their parcel on the map, receive 20-year NASA POWER + SMAP + MODIS diagnostics, identify climate-resilient crops for 2035–2050, inspect a 12-month frost/irrigation calendar, and print a 1-click PDF field plan.
- Tier 2 — Plug & Play USB / Local AP Mode (Small-Medium Producers, Rural Technical Schools & Cooperatives, 15–200 ha): Using that same PC and our 4-second automatic flasher (FLASHEAR_ESP32_TERRASHIFT.bat), users connect an ESP32 Gateway via USB WebSerial or offline Wi-Fi AP (192.168.4.1) and add 1 to 5 open-hardware Solar + LoRa/ESP-NOW field nodes one by one according to farm priorities.
- Tier 3 — 30 km LoRa Mesh + Industrial SCADA Mode (Large Agribusiness & Estates, 200–10,000+ ha): Deploys dozens of Solar + LoRa 915 MHz (15–30 km) nodes, hilltop repeaters, and silobag lances bridged directly via Modbus TCP (Port 502) and isolated RS485 into industrial PLCs (Siemens, Schneider, Allen-Bradley), high-power VFD irrigation pumps, and enterprise SCADA historians.

6 Plug-and-Play Zero-Signal Rural Devices (Powered by One Shared Solar + LiFePO4 + LoRa 915 MHz + ESP32 Motherboard):
1. Solar Frost & Thermal-Inversion Sentinel Node (Calamuchita Valleys, Vine, Olive & Chickpea): Pairs Solar ESP32 + LoRa with two industrial PT100 (4–20 mA) probes at 40 cm and 1.80 m height plus a zero-idle-power Reed Switch cup anemometer and rain gauge; detects local -2 C cold-air pooling invisible to macro satellite pixels, firing a 15 km LoRa alert and triggering anti-frost irrigation automatically.
2. Solar Bi-Stable Latching Solenoid Valve + Burst-Pipe Detector Node: Drives 9V/12V bi-stable latching valves with a 50 ms H-bridge pulse (DRV8871) holding open at 0.00 mA continuous draw, paired with an inline pulse/4–20 mA flowmeter that autonomously shuts off any branch with zero flow (clogged filter) or 2x surge flow (animal-ruptured drip pipe).
3. Solar Soil-Health Node (NPK + Salinity EC + pH over RS485 Modbus): Connects an IP68 multi-parameter probe to the ESP32 RS485 (MAX485) bus; when NASA MODIS NDVI detects canopy yellowing from orbit, this probe confirms underground whether the cause is water stress, well-water salinization, or nutrient depletion.
4. Solar Australian-Tank, Livestock Trough & Deep-Well Level Monitor (4–20 mA): Uses a submersible stainless-steel hydrostatic level transmitter (4–20 mA) with NAMUR NE43 (<3.6 mA) broken-wire diagnostics to prevent submersible pump dry-run cavitation and empty distant cattle troughs.
5. Hilltop Solar Mesh Repeater (25–30 km) + Tractor / Pickup Cab OLED/E-Ink Monitor: A 300 g IP67 solar repeater relays hidden mountain valley LoRa packets over ridges up to 25–30 km, while a 12V cab-mounted ESP32 + LoRa + OLED/E-Ink display live-harvests plot, tank, and valve status as farmers drive across zero-signal fields.
6. Solar Silobag Grain-Preservation Sentinel Lance (CO2 + Intergranular Moisture — Rio Cuarto Grain Belt): Spear probe monitoring CO2 and intergranular humidity inside isolated field silobags of maize, soybean, sorghum, and chickpea, beaming an instant 10 km LoRa alarm weeks before wildlife bag tears or moisture cause grain spoilage.

### Non-Linear Climate Extremes & Sudden Atmospheric Anomalies (Super El Niño & Polar Vortex Disruptions)
- Super El Niño & ENSO Hydro-Climatic Whiplash (Monitored via NASA Sentinel-6 Michael Freilich, SWOT & GPM IMERG): Multi-year La Niña droughts require crop shifts to sorghum/chickpea and borehole drawdown protection (Node #4), while abrupt transitions into a Super El Niño unleash convective storms, nutrient leaching/salinity shifts (Node #3 RS485 NPK+EC), and grain fermentation inside remote field silobags (Node #6 CO2 Lance).
- Polar Vortex Breakdowns — Arctic (Northern Hemisphere) & Austral/Antarctic (Southern Hemisphere, Monitored via NASA MERRA-2 & GEOS): Accounts for sudden stratospheric warming and Arctic Polar Vortex outbreaks across Northern Hemisphere farmlands as well as Austral/Antarctic Polar Vortex (Southern Annular Mode) spring cold surges into Córdoba, where sub-zero air (-2 C) pools in Calamuchita hollows and Node #1 (Dual PT100 + 15 km LoRa) autonomously triggers anti-frost irrigation.

INTENDED IMPACT & REGIONAL FINDINGS
Regional findings span the real Córdoba agricultural corridor from the Pampas core plains of Río Cuarto (-33.123°, -64.349°) to the serrana valleys of Santa Rosa de Calamuchita (-32.069°, -64.536°). Our model quantifies summer canopy heat stress and rainfall volatility affecting early rainfed maize and first-crop soybean, while revealing strong 2035–2050 resilience and harvest stability for grain sorghum, Kabuli chickpea, high-altitude Malbec vineyards, super-high-density olive, pistachio, and serrana lavender—cutting supplemental water demand by up to 38% with closed-loop drip automation.

TOOLS, LANGUAGES, HARDWARE & AI TRANSPARENCY DISCLOSURE
- Web & Analytics Stack: HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), Leaflet.js (WMTS orbital mapping), Chart.js, KaTeX, WebSerial API (live USB ESP32 bridge), Offline Service Worker (PWA), Guided Neural Voice Tour (EN/ES/PT), Trilingual EN/ES/PT interface, Printable PDF Farm Plan, Auto-Demo Jury Mode.
- Industrial Hardware & Firmware: ESP32 (C++/Arduino), ADS1115 16-bit ADC, 165 Ohm 0.1% shunt, 4–20 mA industrial transmitters (NAMUR NE43), ESP-NOW (AES-128), MAX485 RS485 (Modbus RTU), Modbus TCP (Port 502), ESP32 Preferences NVS.
- Open Repository: https://github.com/inanna-company/terra-shift-scada
- Official Documentation Suite: https://inanna-company.github.io/terra-shift-scada/manuals/index.html
- Ecosystem & Hardware Report: https://inanna-company.github.io/terra-shift-scada/manuals/index.html?doc=m4
- AI / Super Intelligence Disclosure: Core system architecture, agronomic-mechatronic sensor fusion, and industrial NAMUR NE43/ESP-NOW/Modbus engineering are original works by Team INANNA; generative AI (Google Gemini) assisted with UI scaffolding, layout formatting, and English translation.
